<b>Pharlids</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are small arachnids driven by instinct which are found throughout [[Pharloom]].<ref>Pharlid Hunter's Journal entry: <i>"Small arachnid found in many crevices and caves throughout Pharloom (...) their talents are born purely of instinct."</i></ref> Numerous Pharlids were evolved into [[Weavers]] by [[Grand Mother Silk]].<ref>First Sinner post-fight [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nAwTNaLtT34 cutscene].</ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Pharlids move back and forth across floors and walls, dealing {{Damage|1}} on contact. When [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] comes close, they prepare an attack where they swipe and slice their claws in a large range around their bodies, dealing {{Damage|1+1}} if Hornet gets caught.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Pharlids have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* Our caves...
* Our darkness...
* To hide... To nest... To live...
* Always ours...
}}

== Location ==
Pharlids are most numerous in the [[Blasted Steps]]. They can also be found in many out-of-the-way portions of other areas, including the caves of [[Verdania]], parts of the [[Wisp Thicket]], the entrance to [[Sands of Karak]], the eastern [[Underworks]], the outside section of the [[Whispering Vaults]], and the [[Border Caves]] above [[the Cradle]].
